emma: Quick MVP sync 9Optimize advice: batching, KV/prefix cache, quant recommendations, eval-triggered alerts. Need launch criteria + small scope.

raj: I'm in. Suggest shipping batching advisor API first, then cache patterns, then quant recs, then eval alerts. Keep toggleable.

sofia: Field asks: AcmeHealth wants private deploy checklist; EduAI wants embedding cost guidance. I'll draft two short vignettes.

liam: Runtime notes: per-request token cap, max batch concurrency, explicit quant fallback to original model when quality drops. Will prototype harness.

ana: Pilot acceptance: 1 hosted + 1 private pilot using advice with no quality regressions for 2 weeks. Docs: one-pager + console example + API snippet.

raj: API sketch: POST /v1/optimize/advice -> small payload with route metrics; response: batching/cache/quant + 1-line rationale. Keep JSON tiny for Console.

emma: MVP priority list: 1) Batching advisor (per-route suggestions + toggle examples) 2) KV/prefix cache patterns (TTL heuristics) 3) Quant profiles with expected perf/quality deltas + safe-fallback 4) Eval-triggered alerts (concordance, latency, embedding drift).

liam: Safe defaults: batching=off, cache=read-through disabled, quant=off unless safe-fallback enabled. Runtime guard required to avoid OOMs.

ops-bot: deploy scheduled: optimize-advice v0.1 -> staging 2026-04-02 02:00 UTC.

emma: Next steps: Raj = API spec (Tue), Sofia = vignettes, Liam = runtime guards, Ana = pilot coordination. Sync Wed 10am PT. Post blockers here.

raj: I'll draft an OpenAPI snippet and a minimal test vector list.
